text:
I understand your frustration, but the system requires a specific reason for cancellation - either "no longer needed" or "ordered by mistake". These are the only two options available.

Since you mentioned you found a better deal elsewhere, "no longer needed" would be the most appropriate reason to select. This accurately reflects that you no longer want the item because you found a better alternative.

Would you like me to proceed with canceling order #W2417020 with the reason "no longer needed"? The full refund of $2,674.40 will be added back to your gift card balance immediately.
zh:
我理解您的沮丧，但系统要求取消时提供具体原因 - 要么是“不再需要”，要么是“误订”。只有这两个选项可用。

由于您提到在其他地方发现了一个更好的优惠，“不再需要”会是选择的最合适原因。这准确地反映了您因为发现更好的替代品而不再需要该商品。

您希望我以“不再需要”为原因取消订单 #W2417020 吗？全额退款 $2,674.40 将立即返还到您的礼品卡余额中。
